name: k-way merges overlapping windows in ascending order
input: requests 2, 4, and 6 in an eleven-message conversation

name: repeated requests still call the API and duplicate messages appear once
input: two identical requests plus a partially overlapping later window

name: handles empty input and empty boundary windows
input: no IDs, then an ID whose API window is empty
test:
calls = []
def fake_get_chat_messages(message_id):
    calls.append(message_id)
    return []
globals()['get_chat_messages'] = fake_get_chat_messages
assert merge_windows([]) == []
assert merge_windows([99]) == []
assert calls == [99]
